# Orion Electronics Returns Policy

Customers may return most purchases within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method. Opened electronics such as phones, tablets and headphones can be returned within 15 days. Drones and camera gimbals carry a 10 percent restocking fee once the seal is broken.

To start a return, request a return authorisation in your account. Every authorisation number begins with the prefix RMA- followed by six digits, and it must be written on the parcel. Items must include all accessories and the original packaging.

Refunds are processed within 5 business days after the warehouse receives the item. Gift cards, software licence keys and clearance items marked Final Sale cannot be returned. Exchanges for a different colour or size are free of charge.

# Nimbus X14 Laptop Limited Warranty

The Nimbus X14 is covered for two years against manufacturing defects in parts and labour from the date of purchase. The battery is covered for one year or 500 charge cycles, whichever comes first.

Accidental damage such as liquid spills, cracked screens or drops is not covered by the standard warranty. Owners can buy the CarePlus protection plan, product code CP-220, within 60 days of purchase to add accidental damage cover for three years.

To make a claim, complete warranty form W-17 and attach the invoice. Repairs are carried out at an authorised service centre and usually take 7 to 10 working days. Opening the chassis yourself voids the warranty.

# Leave Policy

Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year and 12 days of paid sick leave. Annual leave accrues monthly at two days per month.

Up to 5 unused annual leave days can be carried over into the next year; any further unused days lapse on 31 March. Sick leave cannot be carried over.

The primary caregiver is entitled to 26 weeks of paid parental leave, and the secondary caregiver to 4 weeks. Planned leave longer than three days should be requested at least two weeks in advance through the HR portal. Leave without pay requires approval from a department head.

# Travel and Expense Policy

Employees travelling on company business can claim a daily meal allowance of 1,200 rupees for domestic trips and 60 US dollars for international trips. Original receipts are required for any single expense above 500 rupees.

Claims must be submitted through ExpenseHub within 30 days of the trip ending; late claims need written approval from finance. Flights shorter than six hours must be booked in economy class. Business class is allowed for longer flights only with director approval.

Alcohol, personal entertainment and traffic fines are never reimbursed. Mileage for using a personal car is paid at 12 rupees per kilometre.

# IT Security Guidelines

Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and must not reuse any of your last five passwords. Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for email, the HR portal and source code hosting.

When working outside the office, connect through the SecureLink VPN client before opening any internal system. All company laptops are encrypted with BitLocker, and USB mass storage devices are blocked by policy.

Forward suspicious emails to the security team using the Report Phishing button; do not click links or open attachments from unknown senders. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT service desk within one hour so the device can be wiped remotely.

# AX3000 Wi-Fi Router User Manual

To restore factory settings, press and hold the reset button on the back of the router for 10 seconds until the status light blinks amber. The default administration address is 192.168.8.1 and the default password is printed on the label underneath the router.

Status light meanings: solid white means connected to the internet, blinking white means starting up, and solid red means no internet connection.

Error code E-219 means the WAN cable is unplugged or damaged; check the cable between the router and the modem. Firmware updates are installed from the companion mobile app under Settings, then System. The router broadcasts both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz networks.

# BrewMaster 5 Espresso Machine Manual

Descale the machine every 200 cups or every three months, whichever comes first, using the BrewMaster descaling solution. The removable water tank holds 1.8 litres. Use filtered water to reduce limescale.

Error E04 means the water tank is empty or not seated correctly. Error E07 means the brewing unit is blocked and should be rinsed under warm water.

The steam wand must be wiped and purged after every use to keep milk from drying inside the nozzle. The drip tray should be emptied daily. Never put the brewing unit in a dishwasher.

# Annual Report 2024

Revenue for fiscal year 2024 reached 48.6 crore rupees, an increase of 18 percent over the previous year. Net profit rose to 6.2 crore rupees. Research and development spending was 9 percent of revenue.

During the year the company opened three new offices in Pune, Kochi and Jaipur, bringing the total to eleven. Headcount grew to 412 employees at year end.

The board recommended a dividend of 2 rupees per share. The main risks identified for 2025 are rising cloud infrastructure costs and longer enterprise sales cycles.

# Q3 Sales Review

The North region was the strongest performer in the third quarter with 31 percent of total sales. The East region missed its quarterly target by 7 percent, mainly because two large deals slipped into Q4.

Customer churn fell to 4.2 percent from 5.6 percent in Q2 after the new onboarding programme launched. The Lumen smart lamp was the best-selling product for the second quarter in a row.

Average deal size grew by 11 percent. Next quarter the team will focus on renewals in the education segment and on reducing discounting.

# New Employee Onboarding Guide

On your first day, collect your laptop and access badge from the IT desk on the third floor between 9 and 11 in the morning. Each new hire is paired with a buddy from their team for the first month.

The probation period lasts six months, with a review meeting at the end of month three. Salary is paid on the last working day of each month.

Complete the mandatory security and code of conduct training modules in the learning portal during your first week. Your manager will set your first-quarter goals by the end of week two.

# Python Style Guide

Limit lines to 100 characters. Use type hints on all public functions and prefer f-strings for string formatting. Names of functions and variables use snake_case; classes use CapWords.

Write docstrings in the Google style with Args and Returns sections. Every new module needs unit tests written with pytest, and the test suite must pass before a pull request is merged.

Avoid bare except clauses; catch the specific exception you expect. Imports are grouped as standard library, third-party, then local, separated by blank lines.

# Public API Rate Limits

Each API key may make up to 600 requests per minute, with bursts of up to 100 requests in a single second. Requests above the limit receive HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests together with a Retry-After header that says how many seconds to wait.

Enterprise plans raise the limit to 5,000 requests per minute. API keys expire and must be rotated every 90 days from the developer dashboard.

Webhook deliveries are retried up to five times with exponential backoff. Batch endpoints accept at most 1,000 records per call.

# Production Deployment Runbook

Production deployments happen on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 15:00. A change freeze runs from 20 December to 5 January, during which only emergency fixes are allowed.

Every release starts as a canary on 5 percent of traffic for 30 minutes. If error rates rise above 1 percent, roll back immediately with the command deploy rollback --to previous.

The on-call engineer is paged automatically for failed health checks. Database migrations must be backwards compatible so that a rollback never requires a schema change.

# Lemon Garlic Spaghetti

Serves two. Bring a large pot of salted water to the boil and cook 200 grams of spaghetti for about 10 minutes until al dente.

Meanwhile, gently fry four cloves of sliced garlic in three tablespoons of olive oil until golden. Add the zest and juice of two lemons and a ladle of pasta water.

Toss the drained spaghetti in the pan with 50 grams of grated parmesan and a handful of chopped parsley. Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

# Country Sourdough Loaf

Mix 500 grams of bread flour with 375 grams of water for a hydration of 75 percent, then add 100 grams of active starter and 10 grams of salt.

Let the dough bulk ferment for about five hours at 24 degrees Celsius, folding it every 30 minutes for the first two hours. Shape the loaf and proof it overnight in the fridge.

Bake in a preheated Dutch oven at 230 degrees Celsius for 20 minutes with the lid on, then 25 minutes with the lid off until deeply browned. Cool for at least one hour before slicing.

# Solar System Study Notes

Mars has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos. A day on Mars, called a sol, lasts 24 hours and 37 minutes.

Jupiter is the largest planet and has the Great Red Spot, a storm larger than Earth. Venus is the hottest planet, with surface temperatures around 465 degrees Celsius, because its thick carbon dioxide atmosphere traps heat.

Saturn's rings are made mostly of ice particles. Mercury, the closest planet to the Sun, has almost no atmosphere.

# Photosynthesis Notes

Photosynthesis takes place in chloroplasts. The light-dependent reactions happen in the thylakoid membranes, where chlorophyll absorbs mainly red and blue light and splits water, releasing oxygen.

The Calvin cycle runs in the stroma and uses ATP and NADPH from the light reactions to fix carbon dioxide into sugars such as glucose.

The overall inputs are carbon dioxide, water and light energy; the outputs are glucose and oxygen. Plants appear green because chlorophyll reflects green light.

# City Library Membership Rules

An annual membership costs 500 rupees for adults and is free for children under 12. Members can borrow up to six books at a time for 21 days each.

Loans can be renewed twice online or at the front desk, as long as nobody has reserved the book. The late fee is 5 rupees per book per day.

E-books and audiobooks are available through the LibroApp mobile app using your membership number. Lost books are charged at the replacement price plus a 50 rupee processing fee.

# FitZone Gym Membership Terms

Members may cancel with 30 days written notice; no cancellation fee applies after the minimum term of three months. A membership can be frozen for up to two months per year for travel or medical reasons.

Each member receives four guest passes per month. The joining fee is waived for full-time students who show a valid student ID.

The gym is open from 5 in the morning until 11 at night on weekdays and from 7 until 9 on weekends. Lockers are emptied every night.

# TI-Gold Travel Insurance Policy Summary

Policy TI-Gold covers emergency medical expenses abroad up to 100,000 US dollars per trip. Trip cancellation is reimbursed up to 3,000 dollars when caused by illness, injury or a family emergency.

If checked baggage is delayed for more than 12 hours, the policy pays up to 200 dollars for essential purchases. Lost passports are covered for replacement costs.

Injuries from extreme sports such as skydiving, bungee jumping and motor racing are excluded. Claims must be filed within 30 days of returning home.
